name: Mark Ovland
reason: No published European base: his own site (markovland.uk), his Gaia House teacher bio and his Dharma Seed page say only that he teaches at Gaia House and around the UK, none names a town or region where he lives (an older Everyday Mindfulness interview says he lived in a van), so Near You has nothing to place him by. Otherwise he would qualify: published email mark@markovland.uk, a usable photo on his site, free guided-meditation recordings and Gaia House retreats on 18-22 Dec 2026 and Feb-Mar 2027.
